title: Transfection of Endometrial Cells with siRNA
author: Unknown
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.iztcf6n

steps.title: Seed Endometrial Cells
steps.instruction: Seed 1x 10^5 cells per well of a 24-wellplate with 0.5 ml appropriate culture medium containing serum.

steps.title: Pre-transfection Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the cells under normal growth conditions (typically 37°C and 5% CO2) until transfection.

steps.title: Prepare Transfection Complexes
steps.instruction: Form transfection complexes using siRNA and HiPerFect Transfection Reagent.

substeps.instruction: Dilute 37.5 ng siRNA in 100 μl culture medium without serum
Add 3 μl HiPerFect Transfection Reagent to the diluted siRNA and mix by vortexing
Incubate for 5 min at room temperature (20°C)

steps.title: Apply Complexes to Cells
steps.instruction: Add the transfection complexes drop-wise onto the cells and gently swirl the plate to ensure uniform distribution.

steps.title: Post-transfection Incubation and Monitoring
steps.instruction: Incubate the cells with the transfection complexes under normal growth conditions.
